subject.title: fix(codex): reject hex/exponent computer wait duration strings

question: Should Codex computer duration strings remain a supported compatibility input, and does this watchdog parser exactly match the computer executor’s canonical duration validation?
rationale: The patch is internally correct, but only a maintainer can confirm whether previously coerced string forms are unsupported malformed input or an existing compatibility contract that the watchdog must continue to budget.

options.title: Align execution and watchdog
options.body: Confirm or centralize the computer duration parser so execution and outer-deadline calculation accept exactly the same value forms, then merge with focused integration coverage.

options.title: Approve strict watchdog grammar
options.body: Accept the intentional narrowing as-is after confirming that rejected forms cannot produce longer-running computer actions downstream.

options.title: Preserve current coercion
options.body: Keep the existing compatibility behavior and close or revise this PR if string coercion is considered part of the supported contract.

recommendation.title: Align execution and watchdog
recommendation.body: Confirm or centralize the computer duration parser so execution and outer-deadline calculation accept exactly the same value forms, then merge with focused integration coverage.
